responsibility: This file provides tree-type-aware optab queries and vector-support predicates on top of the lower-level optabs machinery. It maps tree codes and type properties to the correct optab, determines whether conversions, widening operations, vector comparisons, and vector conditional expressions are directly supportable for specific tree vector types, and initializes optimization-node-specific optab tables for targets whose available patterns depend on compilation options.
same_name_distinction: Implements the tree-type-aware layer of the optabs stem, translating tree codes and vector/tree type properties into optab choices and support predicates. Unlike gcc/optabs-tree.h, which only publishes the interface, this file contains the mapping and initialization logic.
